prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 90.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 84.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Pet Generation Waiting Tips Carousel', 'Interactive Pet Controls Guided Flow', 'Pet Care Mini Game Wait Flow', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Command Setup Flow', 'Desktop Rendering Progress and Audio Status Wait Info']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Photo Quality Assistant and Real-Time Pet Preview', 'Sign-In Stalling Recovery Prompt', 'Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Engaging Story Value Proposition Copy', 'Multi-Account Restore Sign-In Hint', 'Desktop Notification Toggle During Wait', 'Story Screen First Onboarding Reordering', 'Interactive Pet Personality & Customizer Stage', 'Desktop Pet Interaction Cheat-Sheet Wait Overlay', 'Split Account Continuity & Restore View', 'Desktop Companion Controls Walkthrough Screen', 'Custom Photo Selection Mascot Guidance', 'Sign-In Verification Desktop Alert', 'Instant Desktop Companion Value Copy', 'Animated Companion Teaser During Setup Wait', 'Post-Adoption Sign-In Step Reordering', 'Direct Photo Customization Value Headline Copy', 'Live Pet Activity Teaser Stream During Wait', 'Desktop Launch Ready Notification Switch', 'Account Data Preservation Incentive', 'Desktop Command Navigation Copy', 'Photo Customization Quality Tips Hint', 'Centered Path Selection Grid', 'Pick Friend Before Sign-In Sequence Shift', 'Adoption Character Stage Full Bleed Redesign', 'Desktop Audio Alert When Generation Completes', 'Companion Setup Status Monitor', 'Desktop Life Companion Onboarding Headline', 'Companion Mood and Voice Sound Test Flow', 'Multi-Device Pet Sync Sign-In Headline', 'Account Cloud Sync Status Verification Flow', 'Desktop Command Practice & Control Sandbox Screen', 'Desktop Readiness Audio Signal & Stage Monitor', 'Companion Path Compact Grid Selection Layout']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Account Persistence Warning and Reset Prevention', 'Spotlight Adoption Certificate Redesign', 'Split Progress & Desktop Readiness Dashboard', 'Photo Formatting Guidelines Hint', 'Path Selection Bonus Badge', 'Desktop Readiness & Display Troubleshooting Guide', 'Desktop Quick Controls Sandbox Redesign', 'Generation Time Estimator & Visual Progress Hint', 'Onboarding Completion Starter Pack Badge', 'Account Sign-In Restore Explainer Redesign', 'Home Intro Desktop Checklist Redesign', 'Pet Naming and Personality Trait Selection Flow', 'Split Layout Home Intro Pet Command Summary', 'Early Adopter Pet Accessory Incentive Badge', 'Two-Column Path Comparison Cards Layout', 'Pick Friend Gallery Carousel Redesign', 'Account Sign-In Sequence Shift', 'Interactive Pet Controls Practice Playground Screen', 'Existing Account Restore Callout Hint', 'Companion Path Starter Toy Incentive', 'Generation Process Time Estimator Timer Display', 'Desktop Display Verification Step Screen', 'Two Column Pet Selector Layout', 'Stage Mode Path Selection Redesign', 'Photo Clarity Guidelines Callout', 'Account Sync Pet Recovery Hint', 'Welcome Starter Toy Unlocking Bonus', 'Story Scroll Path Selection Experience', 'Adoption Certificate First Sequence Shift', 'Custom Pet Accent Palette Unlock Incentive', 'Account Auth Method Continuity Hint', 'Adoption Certificate & Pet Trait Preview Redesign', 'Desktop Control Shortcuts Overview Card']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions consistently overstated gains compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, finish copy, finish notification, home new_flow, sign_in copy, sign_in hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were effective, winning in 2 of 3 tests.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +3.9%), while 5 other tests showed no clear effect.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, and home notification changes across 2 tests each.
Adoption redesign (3 tests), choose_path copy (3 tests), adoption hint (2 tests), sign_in notification (2 tests), and sign_in reorder (2 tests) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Voice & Speech Guided Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive voice command practice flow on the home_intro screen where users can speak and test basic pet commands right before completing setup.
candidates.why: Interactive finish flows won in 2 out of 3 past experiments, and support received multiple complaints from users unclear on how to talk to or control their pets.

components.text: Try saying Hello or asking your pet to sit directly from your desktop!

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Selection Card Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a grid layout featuring character audio previews and highlighted pet traits.
candidates.why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion in the funnel (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s); a clearer visual selection grid helps users decide faster.

pick_friend.headline: Select Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Pick a companion personality to bring to life on your desktop screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control & Visibility Quick-Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a new dedicated screen after home_intro explaining shortcut keys to hide, dock, summon, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support logs show 3 emails regarding confusion over hiding/controlling pets and 4 emails about feature controls post-onboarding.

new_pet_visibility_guide.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_visibility_guide.body: Learn simple shortcuts to summon, minimize, or command your desktop companion anytime.

components.text: Press Alt+P anytime to show or hide your pet instantly on your screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Care Companion Idle Activity Mini-Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive pet feeding and care mini-activity directly into the waiting screen while desktop assets render in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting stage in the home step has a very high mean time (2336s). Active engagement keeps users entertained while background rendering completes.

components.text: Your pet is getting cozy and hungry while preparing to spawn on your screen!

candidates.title: Re-Sign-In Account Continuity & Pet Persistence Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the sign_in screen to explicitly explain that logging into an existing account restores and preserves existing pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, causing churn at sign-in (72.9% step conversion).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep & Restore Your Pet
sign_in.body: Log into your account to automatically sync and safeguard your pet memory, traits, and history across sessions.

candidates.title: Interactive Waiting Progress & Desktop Stage Checklist
candidates.change: Update the waiting screen to display real-time rendering stage progress and step count indicators.
candidates.why: Home wait_info improvements previously yielded positive lifts (+4.2% and +3.9%), reassuring users during long generation processes.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Pet Desktop Assets
waiting.body: We are assembling custom animations, sound triggers, and desktop display graphics.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet First Day Welcome Toy Incentive
candidates.change: Highlight a free welcome toy item on the home_intro screen that gets placed on the user's desktop immediately upon finishing setup.
candidates.why: Providing an immediate reward incentive at the final step encourages users to complete onboarding (84.2% step conversion).

home_intro.hint: Finish setup now to unlock your pet's first interactive desktop toy!

candidates.title: Custom Photo Lighting and Pose Preparation Hint
candidates.change: Add hint text on upload_photos detailing lighting and camera angles for optimal pet photo rendering.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect, which contributes to drop-off in the adoption step.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload a well-lit photo showing your pet facing forward clearly without background objects.

candidates.title: Clear Desktop Companion Mode Selection Value Copy
candidates.change: Rewrite the headline and body on choose_path to clearly distinguish between instant adoption of ready pets and custom photo pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and a mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation or confusion on path selection.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Adoption for curated ready-to-play pets, or Custom Creation to transform your photo into a desktop companion.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Complete Notification Switch
candidates.change: Enable notify_when_ready and alert hints on home_intro so users are notified as soon as their pet appears on their desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not appearing on desktop or users missing the desktop spawn event during finish setup.

home_intro.hint: We'll notify your system tray the moment your pet walks onto your screen.
